## Menu focus and trailer reliability

- Prevent unrelated Up, Left and Back presses inside content from authorizing automatic menu focus when a control disappears.
- Allow menu entry through explicit navigation requests or the content boundary, targeting the current tab. Restore content focus when an unauthorized menu transfer occurs.
- Keep hidden top-menu dropdowns from expanding after rejected focus transfers. Returning home from Settings focuses Home content rather than opening the menu.
- Include hardware-supported VP9 trailer preference with H.264 fallback, native trailer extraction without yt-dlp, and opt-in detailed trailer diagnostics from the preceding local builds.

Signed 32-bit Android TV build. Physical-device focus and trailer quality verification remains necessary.
